_readme: AgentForge eval results. 'measured' = a recorded run in that week's package; 'gate' = the check and its floor, with no committed run. The portfolioagent_routing_gate section is written by eval_run.py; everything else is curated from the weekly packages.

w02_model_benchmark.measured: nano 93.3% (p95 1185 ms), mini 90.0% (p95 4665 ms), qwen3:0.6b 66.7%; an earlier run tied mini and nano at 90.0%

w05_groundedness.gate: refuse unless top-1 cosine >= 0.55 and spread >= 0.08

w06_before_after.gate: W5 baseline vs full pipeline on the same rows; deterministic proxies, one row moves a rate by 0.10

w07_breakrag.measured: none on record - a pre-fix red run was withdrawn because the harness was broken

w08_lora.measured: eval loss 2.27 -> 2.21 (best, epoch 2) -> 2.24 -> 2.30 (trainer_state.json); train loss 2.86 -> ~1.5; ~2.3M trainable params (0.38%)

w09_agent_scenarios.measured: 3/5 pass - the 2 failures are built in

w11_tool_pick.gate: accuracy compared for good vs vague tool descriptions

w12_guardian.gate: accuracy per behaviour; pii_leaks must be 0

w16_costguard_routing.measured: 10/10 correct (floor 0.9); $0.004559 actual vs $0.010722 all-frontier; 57.5% saved (floor 40%), ~2.35x cheaper

portfolioagent_routing_gate._readme: Produced by eval_run.py over data/eval_golden.jsonl: 27 frozen questions about the capstone, labelled with the tier a human expects. Prompt tokens are the first call's input (system prompt, tool schemas, question); replace the golden set with your own before you quote these.

cost._note: ceiling_usd_per_request is the one number here that is real and enforced: app/budget.py rejects any request whose projected cost exceeds it (413), and GET /health reports it. savings_ratio_x is the all-frontier bill divided by the routed-mix bill on the same tokens.

tests._note: The eval gate below fails CI if overall_score drops under the floor.
